'''Tuk'ata nobilis''' were a pair of [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]] tamed by the [[Jedi Beast Master]] [[Kanzhei Opli]] three centuries before the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and given to the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose|Jedi Temple]] of [[Vaklin]] approximately three hundred years before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. They were distinguished from the original strain by their [[Color/Legends|blue]] eyes in comparison with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-sided]] red eyes of a normal tuk'ata. The only two specimens were killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in 19 BBY.<ref name="Purge">[[Purge – The Tyrant's Fist 2|''Purge – The Tyrant's Fist'' 2]]</ref>
